sections.description: The core bridge between Exacoat Manager ERP, WooCommerce orders, custom status, and fulfillment tracking.
sections.changelog:
### Version 0.1.38
- Removed redundant hex text field next to wand button in Hardware Body Colors
- Resolved cross-origin canvas security failure on dominant color extraction via CORS-safe blob loading
- Added native hex sanitization to eliminate browser invalid CSS color format console warnings
- Added automatic color detection on chassis image input blur and media library selection
